nodes.label: Price Source Priority Order
nodes.rationale: Same-region valid written contractor quote > same-region completed historical case > traceable brand/supplier price > public-works or open data reference > pending_quote. DEMO_ONLY sits outside this official ordering and is used only when ROOMPILOT_DEMO_MODE=true.

nodes.label: Non-Interchangeable Price Types
nodes.rationale: Retail material price is not a labour-and-material contract price; a worker's base wage is not the customer labour unit price; a public-works reference price is not a private residential transaction price; a web article price is not a formal contractor quote.

nodes.label: Productivity Record Requirements
nodes.rationale: Must record work_item_code, daily_productivity, crew_count, preparation_days, waiting_days, applicability conditions, date/source and confidence. A real schedule additionally weighs material lead time, community construction hours, floor and haulage, substrate condition, actual crew size and whether trades can run in parallel.

nodes.label: Price Status Display Labels
nodes.rationale: demo_reference, pending_quote, historical_reference, contractor_confirmed and productivity_data_missing each map to explicit user-facing wording so the UI can never present a demo or missing number as a confirmed quote.
